title: Update on Review to Extend Working Mother's Child Relief and Parenthood Tax Rebate to Single Unwed Parents
what_it_is: Update on Review to Extend Working Mother's Child Relief and Parenthood Tax Rebate to Single Unwed Parents

sections.label: Parenthood Tax Rebate review update
sections.summary: The Ministry states all Singaporean children receive benefits regardless of parents' marital status, and that the Parenthood Tax Rebate supports parenthood within marriage.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Finance (a) whether the Ministry can provide an update on the findings of its review to extend the Parenthood Tax Rebate to single unwed parents; and (b) if the review has not been completed, when will the results of the review be available.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: As MOF explained then, all Singaporean children receive substantial benefits that support their growth and development from the Government, regardless of their parents’ marital status.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: These include: (a) Child Development Account benefits, including the $3,000 First Step Grant and matched co-savings from Government; (b) $4,000 in MediSave Grant for Newborns; (c) MediShield Life coverage from birth; (d) over $180,000 of education subsidies by the time they turn 16 years old, including pre-school subsidies; and (e) Government healthcare subsidies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Working mothers, regardless of their marital status, are also entitled to: (a) 16 weeks of Government-Paid Maternity Leave; (b) six days paid Child Care Leave per year for children aged below seven years, or two days for children aged seven to 12; and (c) concessionary Migrant Domestic Worker Levy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The Working Mother’s Child Relief and Parenthood Tax Rebate were instituted to encourage women to continue working after their marriage and childbirth, and to support parenthood within marriage and should be seen in that context.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The Government will continue to work with our community partners to support vulnerable single parents.

sections.label: Supporting single mothers
sections.summary: The speaker says the Government is committed to supporting single mothers and will do its best to ensure they are supported.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I hope MOF will review this again and include single unwed mothers and father in our Parenthood Tax rebate and the Working Mother's Child Relief for the mothers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: I would say this: we too are committed to supporting single mothers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: We must be careful not to just transplant or think that a measure that is for one social objective can just be transplanted or extended to meet another social objective.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: I think what I can say is this: we will do our best to ensure that single mothers are supported.

sections.label: Checking measures application
sections.summary: The speaker says the specific question about the application of the measures will be checked and responded to.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The specific question that the Member had about the application of the measures, I will check that and we will respond to him.
